chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) whose summary had previously appeared in one narration, we mention it here in another narration due to the difference between the two narrations.
ai.seo_question: Why is this sermon repeated in Nahj al-Balagha with a different narration?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi includes this variant narration to demonstrate the richness of the oral tradition and the rhetorical versatility of Imam Ali (AS) in addressing the transient nature of worldly life. This comparative approach underscores the scholarly emphasis on *talaqqi* (receiving multiple chains of transmission) to preserve the authenticity and depth of the sermon's eschatological message.
